name: performance-card
title: Performance Card
description: A card whose header pairs a thumbnail or avatar with a title, a meta row and stat tiles, and whose border also wraps whatever follows, such as a table. Uses namespace exports: PerformanceCard.Root, Header, Media, Title, Rule, Meta, Stats, Stat, Metric.

docs.lead: One border around a subject and its numbers. The header holds the media, title, meta row and stat tiles; anything after it, such as a table, carries the header's inset.
docs.usage:
import * as PerformanceCard from "@/components/ui/performance-card"

<PerformanceCard.Root>
  <PerformanceCard.Header media={<PerformanceCard.Media className="size-36" />}>
    <PerformanceCard.Title>Person name</PerformanceCard.Title>
    <PerformanceCard.Meta>In-person meeting</PerformanceCard.Meta>
    <PerformanceCard.Stats>
      <PerformanceCard.Stat value={214} label="Bookings" />
      <PerformanceCard.Metric value={240} label="Tickets sold" delta={-5.4} comparison="vs last week" />
    </PerformanceCard.Stats>
  </PerformanceCard.Header>
</PerformanceCard.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A wide thumbnail, a truncating title, a meta row of icons, text and badges, and tiles of a figure and its label. The media takes a width only, so it fills the header's height and its bottom edge lines up with the tiles.

examples.title: With sub-labels
examples.description: Sub-labels sit on the title's baseline, each behind a rule. The media falls back to its placeholder when there is no image.

examples.title: With a change
examples.description: Use Metric instead of Stat when the figure carries its change against another period. The arrow gives the direction, green up and red down, and the percentage is unsigned.
examples.code:
<PerformanceCard.Metric
  value={240}
  label="Total tickets sold"
  delta={-5.4}
  comparison="vs last week"
/>

examples.title: With content below
examples.description: Root has no padding, so content under the header sets its own. Match the header's 24px inset and a table's header band sits inside the card, as the design draws it.

api.name: PerformanceCard.Root
api.description: The card's single border. No padding of its own, so each part sets its own: the header's 24px inset is what content below it should match.

api.name: PerformanceCard.Header
api.description: The padded top of the card. 24px padding, 16px between the media and the rest.

props.name: media
props.description: A Media, to the left of the children

props.name: action
props.description: Sits top right, level with the title. Usually a Button

api.name: PerformanceCard.Media
api.description: The thumbnail or avatar. Give it a width and it fills the header's height, so its bottom edge lines up with the stat tiles. A square avatar can take size- instead.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown instead of the image when there is no src

api.name: PerformanceCard.Title
api.description: The card's name. Size it with className: text-title-h6 for a wide card, the default text-label-lg for a compact one.

props.name: sublabels
props.description: Sit on the title's baseline, each behind a rule

api.name: PerformanceCard.Rule
api.description: The 1px rule between a title's sub-labels, or between groups in the meta row.

api.name: PerformanceCard.Meta
api.description: The wrapping row of icons, text and badges under the title, 8px below it.

api.name: PerformanceCard.Stats
api.description: The row of tiles, 12px under the meta row. Tiles share the width equally.

api.name: PerformanceCard.Stat
api.description: One tile: the figure and its label.

props.name: value
props.description: A number is formatted with toLocaleString; a string is shown as given

api.name: PerformanceCard.Metric
api.description: A tile that also carries its change against another period. Takes Stat's props too.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change against the comparison period, in percent. The arrow carries the direction, so the percentage is shown unsigned

props.name: comparison
props.description: What the delta compares against, such as "vs last week"
